cases.sentence: Скоро Даниил так отличился среди сатрапов и сановников своими ___, что царь уже думал поставить его над всем царством.
cases.explain: «исключительными качествами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

cases.sentence: Тогда сановники и сатрапы стали искать предлог, чтобы обвинить Даниила в ___ царских дел.
cases.explain: «неверном ведении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

cases.sentence: Тогда сановники и сатрапы стали искать предлог, чтобы обвинить Даниила в неверном ведении ___.
cases.explain: «царских дел» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

cases.sentence: Тогда они пошли к царю и говорили с ним о его ___:
cases.explain: «царском запрете» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: “Haven’t you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?” The king answered, “This thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

cases.sentence: При ___ зари царь встал и поспешил к яме со львами.
cases.explain: «первом свете» — after the preposition «при», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.

cases.sentence: Приблизившись к яме, он позвал Даниила ___:
cases.explain: «жалобным голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: When he came near to the den to Daniel, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?”
